- What we’ll provide: SOC 2 packet + short answers to the residency question, a cost/throughput sketch for peak patterns, and a 30-min follow-up with our security eng if useful.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Hi Ava —

Apologies for the delay. Procurement and security are juggling a couple of higher-priority audits right now. A couple quick clarifications from security so we can move this internally: 

1) Data residency — can your Dedicated deployment guarantee EU-only storage for profile vectors and related logs? Is there an export/ingress control we can use to lock data to a region?
2) Subprocessor list — we need an up-to-date list and confirmation on any third parties that will see raw telemetry.
3) Retention/archival — what is default log retention and can it be shortened per-customer?

I’ve attached a short doc with procurement’s first-pass questions (sunrise_questions_20270419.docx). If we can get answers to 1–3 this week, I’ll try to push procurement to prioritize. Otherwise, timeline slips another 2–3 weeks.

Thanks,

Thanks for the clarity, Alex — really helpful. Short answers below and happy to expand on any item on a 20–30 minute call with Stephanie (cc’d), our security engineering lead.

1) Data residency: yes — our Dedicated offering can be configured to restrict storage and compute to a single cloud region. We support EU regions (Frankfurt, Dublin). We also offer VPC peering and customer-managed encryption keys (KMS) for extra control.

2) Subprocessors: current list is included in the SOC 2 packet appendix (see attachment) and we will supply an updated subprocessor CSV if you need a granular export.

3) Retention: default application logs retained 90 days; audit logs retained 365 days by default. We can set custom retention per-account down to 30 days for logs and archive options for longer-term storage.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll schedule a 20-min call with Stephanie and your security lead this week (available Tue/Wed afternoon PT).
- If procurement wants a redline to the MSA, we can accept an initial non-binding redline to speed review; otherwise I can share a DocuSign starter link to capture PO intent.

If you confirm availability, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Ava Chen
